title: How Ambanis Became So Rich?

From a small-town boy with no money to the man who changed India’s business destiny — this is the complete life story of Dhirubhai Ambani.

Dhirubhai Ambani didn’t just build a company. He built a new idea of Indian capitalism — where ordinary people could own shares, dream big, and challenge global giants. This documentary traces his life from the dusty streets of Chorwad to the creation of Reliance, and how one man rewrote the rules of business forever.

Primary Source - Ambani & Sons (Book by Hamish McDonald)
